raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Apr 2026 – Jun 2026 Software Engineer — Kathanika, Hyderabad • Developed React Native apps and Vue 3 admin dashboards using event-driven Node.js microservices, Kafka, and BullMQ, supporting 10,000+ users. • Built AI-powered semantic search using Typesense, LLM integration, Redis, and user behavior–based ranking, improving search relevance by 40%
and reducing response time by 60%.
Integrated Razorpay (Web), Google Pay, and Apple In-App Purchases (RevenueCat), implementing secure payment processing, backend validation, and subscription reconciliation while maintaining up to 0.5% transaction failure rate.
Configured self-hosted CI/CD pipelines using Coolify, Docker, and GitHub Actions, automating deployments and environment management. • Built a Server-Sent Events (SSE) architecture for real-time AI generation updates, reducing API requests by ~80%. • Managed end-to-end Android and iOS application releases using Google Play Console, App Store Connect, and TestFlight, while integrating Firebase Analytics, Deep Linking, and Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) for user analytics, attribution, and real-time engagement.
Built an AI-powered administrative assistant using LangGraph, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and the OpenAI Responses API, enabling intelligent business analytics, application management, and automated administrative workflows.
Jul 2025 – Feb 2026
Sr. Software Engineer — Max Trans Systems, Hyderabad • Led the migration of a Node.js monolith to a modular NestJS architecture, reducing onboarding time by 50%. • Reduced client-side API calls by 35% through reusable component architecture, improving page load time by ~800ms. • Implemented Redis caching and rate limiting, lowering database load by 30% and API latency from ~400ms to ~120ms. • Built a zero-downtime data migration pipeline processing 50,000+ records with a 0.1% fault rate. • Developed an AI-powered document intelligence solution using RAG, FastAPI, semantic search, and vector embeddings for contextual document
retrieval.
Integrated Stripe payments with secure webhook processing and Ngrok-based local testing for reliable transaction handling.
Apr 2025 – Jun 2025 Freelance — Nexg Works, Hyderabad • Implemented Google OIDC authentication, JWT-based authorization, 2FA, CSP, IP tracking, and bot protection, reducing unauthorized access by 90%. • Automated PDF generation and reporting workflows handling 500+ daily requests with zero manual intervention. • Implemented HIPAA-aligned authorization with RBAC, token rotation, and refresh-token invalidation. • Established GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, reducing deployment effort by 40% and deployment errors by 60%. • Leveraged Azure AI Search to reduce database queries by 60% and improved search response time.
Software Developer — Aadvi Tech Solution, Hyderabad • Delivered 3+ production-grade full-stack applications serving thousands of active users across web and mobile. • Improved Lighthouse performance score by 30% through Redux optimization and lazy loading (TTI: 3.2s → 2.1s). • Introduced WebSocket-based real-time notifications and asynchronous job processing, achieving sub-100 ms latency. • Maintained 80% Jest unit test coverage while actively participating in Agile ceremonies and peer code reviews. • Integrated AWS S3 and SES for secure file management and automated transactional email notifications.
Jul 2023 – Mar 2025
